categories.title: Save Point
categories.info: Interact with save points to replenish Sora's health, make a manual save, or travel to new worlds.

categories.title: Lucky Emblem
categories.info: Use Sora's camera to reveal a "Hidden Mickey" in the environment. These sneaky collectibles often require creative perspectives to line up all elements of the Lucky Emblem.

categories.title: Battlegate
categories.info:
After finishing the main story, return to previous worlds to find new combat scenarios for Sora to face. Interact with the blue spiked orb to start the challenge.

Complete all Battlegates to unlock a secret boss.

categories.title: Classic Kingdom
categories.info:
A trip down memory lane! These mini-games mimic classic Game & Watch handhelds from the 1980's. 

Found by opening chests or examining game posters. Once obtained, they can be played anytime from the Gummiphone menu. Play all Classic Kingdom games at least once to earn the **Classic Tone Keyblade**.

categories.title: Flantastic Seven
categories.info:
Keep an eye out for large fruit sitting atop a crown pedestal! Summon the Flan Heartless with the "Boinnng!" Command.

Each of the Flantastic Seven have a unique fruit reward, which you'll need for the recipes at Little Chef’s Bistro in Traverse Town. If you reach ????, the Flan will also unlock a unique ability for Sora!

categories.title: Ingredient
categories.info:
Want to cook meals at Little's Chef's [Le Grand Bistrot](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-hearts-3/maps/twilight-town?locationIds=386585) in Traverse Town? Sora will need ingredients first!

Ingredients can be found by harvesting plants via Command prompts or striking food sources. They will respawn after exiting and re-entering a world.
